options.antialiasing.tooltip:
FXAA smooths the world and held items before the HUD is drawn. It can soften fine details.

SMAA and TAA are not implemented yet. Iris/Sodium support is planned for phase two.
options.antialiasing.status.not_implemen: Status: selected mode is not implemented
options.antialiasing.status.missing_inpu: Status: required rendering input is unavailable
options.antialiasing.status.failed: Status: rendering failed; see the log. Reload resources or change mode to retry.
